title: 第一卷 第4章 卷入宫斗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

次日清晨，天光未透，叶笙歌便醒了。

他摸了摸下颌，一夜之间，新生的胡茬已有些扎手。

这假太监的身份，此刻比什么都烫手。

他从行囊里翻出一把磨得锋利的小刀，对着铜盆里晃荡的水影，他咬了咬牙，手起刀落。

细微的刺痛传来，伴随着几缕血丝。他动作很快，也很生疏，毕竟从前都是用电动剃须刀。

下颌和唇上被刮得发红，还有些火辣辣的疼，但总算清理干净了。

他将带血的布巾和胡茬小心处理掉，换了那身新赏的靛蓝色宦官常服，理了理衣襟，这才推开房门。

清晨的皇宫雾气氤氲，空气湿冷。叶笙歌凭着记忆，朝尚膳监走去，要去交接一下工作。

见到叶笙歌进来，几个正在洒扫的小太监先是一愣，随即放下手里的活计，围了上来，脸上堆着感激又讨好的笑。

“叶……叶公公来了！”

“给叶公公请安！”

“多谢叶公公救命之恩！”

七嘴八舌，情真意切。昨日若不是叶笙歌出头，他们此刻已是杖下亡魂。

叶笙歌摆摆手，一脸谦和：“各位公公折煞我了，都是为主子们办差，侥幸而已，谈不上恩不恩的。”

正说着，一个略显沙哑的声音从里面传来：“是小叶子来了？进来吧。”

是赵公公。

他躺在靠窗的矮榻上，脸色蜡黄，气色很差，臀部垫着厚厚的软垫，显然是挨了一顿板子。

叶笙歌走进屋，躬身行礼：“赵公公。”

“快别多礼了，坐。”赵公公挣扎着想坐起来，牵动伤处，疼得龇了龇牙。

叶笙歌在榻边的矮凳上坐了半个屁股，以示恭敬。

赵公公看着他，眼神复杂，“小叶子，这次多亏了你。咱家这条老命，还有尚膳监这几十号人，都是你从鬼门关拉回来的。这份情，咱家记下了。”

“公公言重了。”叶笙歌垂眼，“若非公公平日教导，奴才也无昨日胆识。说到底，是意外，谁都不愿看到。如今大家平安，便是万幸。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the early morning of the next day, Ye Shengge woke up before daylight came through.

He touched his chin. The new stubble overnight had become a bit prickly.

The identity of this fake eunuch is hotter than anything else at the moment.

He took out a sharpened knife from his bag, gritted his teeth and raised the knife while facing the water shadow swaying in the copper basin.

A slight stinging sensation came, accompanied by a few streaks of blood.He moved very quickly and very unfamiliarly, after all, he had always used an electric shaver before.

The chin and lips were scratched red and there was some burning pain, but they were finally cleaned up.

He carefully disposed of the bloody cloth and stubble, changed into his new indigo eunuch uniform, straightened his clothes, and then opened the door.

The palace in the early morning was filled with mist and the air was damp and cold.Ye Shengge relied on his memory and walked towards Shang Shan Supervisor to hand over the work.

Seeing Ye Shengge come in, the few young eunuchs who were cleaning were stunned for a moment, then put down their work and gathered around him, with grateful and flattering smiles on their faces.

"Ye...Eunuch Ye is here!"

"Greetings to Eunuch Ye!"

"Thank you so much, Eunuch Ye, for saving your life!"

Lots of talk, sincere love.If Ye Shengge hadn't stepped forward yesterday, they would have been dead souls under the stick at this moment.

Ye Shengge waved his hands with a humble look on his face: "My father-in-law, you are all trying to offend me because you are doing errands for your masters. It's just a fluke, not a kindness."

Just as he was talking, a slightly hoarse voice came from inside: "Is it Little Ye Zi here? Come in."

It's Eunuch Zhao.

He was lying on the low couch by the window, his face was sallow, his complexion was very poor, his buttocks were padded with thick cushions, it was obvious that he had received a beating.

Ye Shengge walked into the room and bowed and saluted: "Eunuch Zhao."

"Stop being so polite and sit down." Eunuch Zhao struggled to sit up and rubbed the injured area, grimacing in pain.

Ye Shengge sat halfway down on the low stool next to the couch as a sign of respect.

Eunuch Zhao looked at him with complicated eyes, "Little Ye Zi, it's all thanks to you this time. Our family's fate, as well as dozens of people like Shang Shanjian, were all brought back from hell by you. Our family will remember this love."

"My father-in-law said something serious." Ye Shengge lowered his eyes, "If it hadn't been for my father-in-law's daily instruction, my slaves wouldn't be as courageous as they were yesterday. In the end, it was an accident, and no one wants to see it. It's a blessing that everyone is safe now."
